J. R.    26 - 10 - 37

Youth's War Time Working Group - Activities

The Youth's War Time Working Group, 150 Boulevard
de Montigny, which was organized by members of the Cultural
Circles Race Salvation Association and the All Shanghai

Association for the Support of Armed Resistance, is now
enlisting members for the purpose of assisting in the
proposed campaign by local national salvation organizations
of soliciting contributions from the public towards the
fund for the purchase of gloves and cotton padded vests
for the Chinese troops.

The Chairman of the Group is one named Chun Chien-
nan (龔劍南), ex-employee of the Andersen Meyer & Co.
At present, the group has about thirty members.
page_data.zh:
J. R.    1937年10月26日

青年战时工作团 - 活动

青年战时工作团，地址蒙梯尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）150号，由文化界救亡协会和全上海武装抗日后援会成员组织成立，目前正招募成员，旨在协助本地救国组织拟开展的向公众募捐活动，所筹款项用于为中国军队购买手套和棉背心。

该团主席名为龚剑南（Chun Chien-nan），系前安达斯·梅耶公司（Andersen Meyer & Co.）职员。目前，该团约有三十名成员。

CONFIDENTIAL    REPORT    Date September 11, 9 41.
Subject (in full) Removal of Gasoline from Pootung.
Made by D.S.I. Cornwell    Forwarded by D.S.I. Wilcox

Enquiries at the petroleum-oil companies
in Shanghai reveal that there is definitely no
restrictions on the removal of oil and gasoline
supplies from the Pootung installations to Shanghai.
The Japanese Naval Authorities enforced a
permit system some years ago for the export of
gasoline from Shanghai to the outports and interior
of China. This system does not apply to Shanghai.
The oil companies are aware that a
certain amount of smuggling and bribery is going
on in Pootung but this again refers to supplies for
the interior and not to Shanghai.

机密    报告    日期：1941年9月11日。
主题（全称）：从浦东运出汽油。
制作人：D.S.I. Cornwell    转呈人：D.S.I. Wilcox

经向上海的石油公司查询，证实从浦东设施向上海运送石油和汽油供应品绝对没有任何限制。日本海军当局数年前曾实施许可证制度，管制从上海向中国其他口岸及内地出口汽油。该制度不适用于上海境内。石油公司知悉浦东存在一定程度的走私和贿赂行为，但这再次是指向内地的供应，而非指向上海。

1941年9月11日。

从浦东运出汽油。

经向上海的石油公司查询，证实从浦东设施向上海运送石油和汽油供应品绝对没有任何限制。日本海军当局数年前曾实施许可证制度，管制从上海向中国其他口岸及内地出口汽油。该制度不适用于上海境内。石油公司知悉浦东存在一定程度的走私和贿赂行为，但这再次是指向内地的供应，而非指向上海。

page_data.en:
September 10, 1941.

Japanese restrictions on removal of gasoline
from Pootung

The following petroleum companies have
oil depots in Pootung :-
Asiatic Petroleum Co.
Standard Oil Co.
Texas Co.
Kwang Wha Petroleum Co.

According to country people from Pootung,
the Japanese Naval Authorities have ordered that
as from September 1 no gasoline shall be transported
from Pootung without first obtaining a permit from
the Japanese Naval Authorities. However, gasoline
is being smuggled out of Pootung by bribing the
Chinese employees and junior Japanese employees of
the Harbour Affairs Department of the Japanese Navy
as well as members of the Kao Jao Police Bureau.
The smuggled gasoline is loaded on native boats at
Tungkeu, Pootung, during the night.

El.
10 Q.H.
S.I.

This story was denied
last week by the oil
Cos. Please check again

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SEP 10 1941 ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER SPECIAL BRANCH）
page_data.zh:
1941年9月10日。

日本对从浦东运出汽油的限制

以下石油公司在浦东设有油库：
亚细亚火油公司（Asiatic Petroleum Co.）
美孚石油公司（Standard Oil Co.）
德士古公司（Texas Co.）
光华石油公司（Kwang Wha Petroleum Co.）

据来自浦东的乡民称，日本海军当局已下令，自9月1日起，未经日本海军当局事先颁发许可证，不得从浦东运输任何汽油。然而，通过贿赂日本海军港务局的中国雇员和日本下级雇员，以及高桥警察局（Kao Jao Police Bureau）的成员，汽油正被从浦东走私出去。走私的汽油在夜间于浦东东沟（Tungkeu）装上民船。

El.
10 Q.H.
S.I.

石油公司上周否认了
这一说法。请再次核查

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1941年9月10日 特务科助理总监）

Subject Stocks of Fuel Oil in the Shanghai Area

Made by D.S.I. Laurier Forwarded by C. Garsia A.S

The following information has been obtained in
connection with the fuel oil situation in Shanghai:

The Standard Vacuum Oil Company
Diesel Fuel Oil 7,500 tons
Bunker Fuel Oil Grade "C" 600 tons.

Gasolene stock figures in respect of this firm
cannot be obtained.

the use of the ships of the United States Navy.

- 2 -
Station,
Date....................'9

Subject....................................................................................................
Made by........................................................Forwarded by....................................................

Of the Grade I Heavy Diesel Fuel Oil,
1,000 tons per month are supplied to foreign warships;
2,000 tons per month to the French Tramways;
1,000 tons per month to the Shanghai Municipal Council.
Of the Special 'Solar Oil,
500 tons per month are sold in Ningpo;
1,000 to 2,000 tons per month are sold to the Chinese
Authorities.
The heavy grade oil now in stock should last for
two months whilst the two lighter oils mentioned are
sufficient for six months supply, respectively.
As regards gasolene, this firm has in stock about
four months' supply which based on the present rate of
consumption for the Shanghai area is equivalent to an
amount in excess of 2,000,000 gallons.
There is no likelihood of a shortage of fuel oil
in Shanghai under existing conditions.
At present the three importers mentioned have
several months' stocks in hand, whilst several tankers
are now en route to this port, and so long as hostilities
do not prevent the passage and off loading of ships there
should be no difficulty in keeping pace with the needs of
the various consumers in Shanghai. One firm is able to
replenish its stocks at from two to three weeks notice
from the Netherlands East Indies where much of its oil comes from.
The foregoing figures cannot be vouched for as
firms, for purely business reasons, do not consider it good
policy to divulge information of this nature. The
figures are therefore submitted with reserve and should be

在一级重质柴油燃料油中，
每月向外国军舰供应1,000吨；
每月向法商电车公司供应2,000吨；
每月向上海公共租界工部局供应1,000吨。
在特种“太阳能油”中，
每月在宁波销售500吨；
每月向中国当局销售1,000至2,000吨。
目前库存的重质油应可维持两个月，而上述两种轻质油分别足以供应六个月。
至于汽油，该公司库存约有四个月的供应量，根据上海地区目前的消耗率计算，相当于超过2,000,000加仑的数量。
在现有条件下，上海出现燃料油短缺的可能性不大。
目前，上述三家进口商手头均有数月的库存，同时有几艘油轮正在驶往本港，只要敌对行动不阻碍船舶通行和卸货，满足上海各类消费者的需求应该没有困难。其中一家公司能够在接到通知后两至三周内从荷属东印度补充库存，其大部分石油即来源于此。
由于纯粹出于商业原因，各公司认为披露此类信息并非良策，因此上述数据无法得到确证。故提交这些数据时应有所保留，并应将其
